subject: Legal & Procurement calendar: owner-level milestones and blockers
messages:
From: Laura Gibbs <laura.gibbs@acme.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Acme Contracts <contracts@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation scope + procurement expectations for Redwood PoC

Vanessa —

Thanks for the demo last week. We'd like to move the PoC into a short evaluation period (2 weeks) and then line up our procurement steps so we can finalize an order quickly. Attached is a short evaluation scope (Acme_Eval_Scope.pdf) that outlines the test prompts, SLAs we expect during the test, and sample datasets.

High-level asks from procurement/legal:
- We need an MSA with standard commercial terms (we generally accept vendor MSA with limited redlines).
- A DPA that includes our encryption & subprocessor naming requirements.
- Order form/PO flow: procurement requires a PO template + vendor bank details to start the PO process.

Timeline we are hoping for: evaluation completed by 7/8, contract signed by 7/15, PO issued by 7/18. That's aggressive for our internal cycles so please let me know where Redwood needs to own sequencing.

Laura
Laura Gibbs
Director, Applied AI Programs — Acme Enterprises

--- Attachment: Acme_Eval_Scope.pdf (1.2MB)
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Laura Gibbs <laura.gibbs@acme.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation scope + procurement expectations for Redwood PoC

Laura — thanks, and appreciate the clarity on timelines. I've sketched a sequencing plan below and assigned owners so we can escalate blockers early. Attached is a short guidance doc for redlines we typically accept (redline-guidance.pdf).

Proposed sequencing (owners & target dates):
1) MSA redline pass (Legal lead) — neha_kapoor — initial redlines to Acme by 6/27; finalize by 7/10 if limited changes.
2) DPA/security review (Security + Legal) — neha_kapoor & rishi_malhotra — initial DPA redlines by 6/27; security evidence (SOC2) by 6/28.
3) Order form / PO details (Sales Ops) — connor_obrien — send order form template + vendor banking info by 6/29; accept PO on or before 7/18.
4) Evaluation sign-off (Customer + Redwood) — vanessa_ortiz — target 7/8 for evaluation completion and handoff to procurement.

Key dependencies / risks:
- If the DPA triggers legal review of encryption/subprocessor clauses, that can add 3–5 business days.
- Order form language around acceptance criteria needs to match the evaluation scope — otherwise procurement will loop procurement legal and extend timeline.

Next steps:
- Neha/rishi: quick redline pass today/tomorrow and share DPA comments with Acme contracts.
- Connor: confirm bank details and prepare an order form aligned to the eval scope by 6/29.
- Vanessa: calendar a 30-min cross-functional sync (we're proposing 7/1) to review the heatmap and escalate any open items.

I'll consolidate everything into a single timeline heatmap once we have initial redlines.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

--- Attachment: redline-guidance.pdf (270KB)
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Acme Contracts <contracts@acme.com>, Laura Gibbs <laura.gibbs@acme.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 27 Jun 2028 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: DPA / MSA initial redlines and open questions

Hi Laura / Acme Contracts —

Attached are our initial redlines for the DPA (DPA_redlines_20280627.pdf). I took a pass at the MSA language relevant to liability, termination, and data processing references inline.

Open items we've flagged that will affect sequencing/time: 
- Data residency: need confirmation whether Acme requires EU-only residency or specific regional controls (this changes whether we need to route to a private deployment option).
- Encryption: Acme requested algorithm-level language; we typically reference encryption-at-rest/in-transit + KMS integration but avoid specifying algorithms in the MSA. If you need algorithm-level commitments, that will need security input and sign-off.
- Indemnity / cap: Acme's proposed cap exceeds our standard terms; if you want to escalate to commercial leadership, please flag a decision by 7/2.

Proposed handling: we can deliver a redline bundle to your contracts team by end of day 6/27 and request a 48–72 hour turnaround on their counter if possible. If they require deeper security language, Rishi will provide a security note and SOC2 export by 6/28.

Please confirm on data residency and whether Acme will accept a standard KMS/HSM reference or needs explicit algorithm commitments.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

--- Attachment: DPA_redlines_20280627.pdf (95KB)
From: Laura Gibbs <laura.gibbs@acme.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Acme Contracts <contracts@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Sat, 29 Jun 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA / MSA initial redlines and open questions

Neha / Vanessa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from procurement/legal here: 
- Data residency: for this PoC Acme is fine with US & multi-region; no EU-only restriction for this engagement.
- Encryption: procurement is happy with the KMS/HSM reference and a high-level statement about AES-256 in transit/at-rest — no algorithm-level SLA required.
- Indemnity/cap: procurement prefers to keep vendor cap within their standard template; we can escalate to our commercial lead if Redwood requires a higher cap.

Procurement note: our PO process requires a populated PO template (attached) + vendor bank details. We typically issue the PO within 3 business days of signed order form. Target dates we mentioned earlier still stand: order issuance by 7/18.

Attached: Acme_PO_template.docx

Laura

--- Attachment: Acme_PO_template.docx (45KB)
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Laura Gibbs <laura.gibbs@acme.com>, Acme Contracts <contracts@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2028 16:50:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated timeline heatmap + 7/1 alignment (30m) — action owners + escalation path

Team / Acme —

I've consolidated the items into a timeline heatmap (procurement_timeline_heatmap_v1.xlsx) and blocked a 30-minute alignment on 7/1 at 10:00 PT — invite sent. The heatmap maps each dependency to an owner and identifies the top 3 blockers that could push us beyond Acme's target sign date of 7/15:

Top blockers (and mitigation):
- DPA encryption/algorithm language: Rishi to provide a security memo by 6/30 and confirm KMS wording — mitigation: accept high-level AES-256 + KMS reference.
- Indemnity cap misalignment: Vanessa to escalate to commercial leadership if Redwood cannot accept Acme cap; decision needed by 7/2.
- Order form acceptance criteria mismatch with eval scope: Connor to align order form to final eval acceptance tests by 6/29 — mitigation: include test checklist in order form.

Action items (owners):
- Neha: deliver MSA/DPA final redline bundle to Acme contracts by EOD 6/30.
- Rishi: SOC2 export + security memo by EOD 6/30.
- Connor: Order form + banking details by 6/29; prep PO-ready docs.
- Vanessa: escalate commercial if indemnity cap cannot be agreed by 7/2; run evaluation sign-off by 7/8.

If any owner anticipates slippage, escalate to me immediately and I'll coordinate an exec-to-exec conversation.

Thanks everyone — see you on 7/1.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
